code: KKR-CPA (package not explicitly named); Monte Carlo code none stated
model_system: Mn-rich Ni-Mn-Z Heusler alloys with chemical disorder, especially Ni45Co5Mn37In13 and Ni50Mn30Ga20 / Ni50Mn25Ga25

key_params.DFT_exchange_method: KKR CPA with Liechtenstein-type exchange constants
key_params.exchange_formula: J_ij from energy integral over scattering matrices and path operators (Eqs. 1-2)
key_params.Hamiltonian: BEG elastic model + Potts magnetic model + magnetoelastic coupling
key_params.BEG_variables: sigma_i = 0, ±1 for austenite and two martensitic variants
key_params.polycrystal_domain_rule: inter-domain interaction probability W = min(1, exp(-|K_ani| M_i^2 /(g mu_B H_ext |M_i|)))
key_params.fields_used: 10 mT and 2 T for Ni45Co5Mn37In13; up to 1.6 T shown for Ni50Mn25Ga25

headline_claim: For Ni45Co5Mn37In13, the calculations reproduce a giant inverse magnetocaloric response with adiabatic temperature change ΔT_ad = -6 K in a 2 T field.
replication_difficulty: high - requires disorder-sensitive KKR-CPA exchange calculations and custom BEG/Potts Monte Carlo with magnetoelastic coupling and hysteresis.
